title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: The last game
hook: It is the last game of the season. What matters most today?
intro: This is the last time this team plays together.
statement: The last game is about the team, not the table.
q1: Do you give every player a special moment —
q2: or play it like any other game?
q3: What do you want them to feel at the last out?
t1: Both can work. But kids remember the season
t2: when it ends with everyone part of it.
cta: Coaches — how do you play the last game?
ctaLines: Everyone plays a new spot. Normal game. A team photo.
ctaPrompt: Share your last game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
It is the last game of the season. What matters most today?
The standings are set. This is the last time this team plays together.
The last game is about the team, not the table.
A special game or play it like any other. There is no single right way.
How do you play the last game? Share your habit in the comments.
